# Milk

[Index](../index.md) · [Rules](../rules.md) · [Sources](../sources.md)

Any milk or cream added to a drink.

- Abstract: it has no members of its own, only its subclasses do.
- Is a: [Ingredient](c-ingredient.md)
- Subclasses: [CondensedMilk](c-condensed-milk.md), [HalfAndHalf](c-half-and-half.md), [WholeMilk](c-whole-milk.md)
- Disjoint with: [Chocolate](c-chocolate.md), [Coffee](c-coffee.md), [Foam](c-foam.md), [Gelato](c-gelato.md), [Water](c-water.md), [WhippedCream](c-whipped-cream.md)
